title: WilmerHale Clinical Professor of Law
bio: Christopher T. Bavitz is the WilmerHale Clinical Professor of Law and Vice Dean for Experiential and Clinical Education at Harvard Law School. He is also Managing Director of HLS’s Cyberlaw Clinic. And, he is a Faculty Co-Director of the Berkman Klein Center. Chris has taught courses such as Counseling and Legal Strategy in the Digital […]
